example : ¬ IsSquare (2 : ℤ) := by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  have h1 : z ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z - 2), hz]
  have h2 : -1 ≤ z := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z + 2), hz]
  interval_cases z <;> norm_num at hz
